text: The conflict was brief; on your side, glorious. This mighty victory, having been achieved utterly without loss, stands without example in history. So long as the planets shall continue to move in their orbits, the Battle Of The Sand-Belt will not perish out of the memories of men. I read it well, and the applause I got was very gratifying to me. I then wound up with these remarks: “The war with the English nation, as a nation, is at an end.
